# ESPN captures

`espn_summary_401909953_core.json`: ESPN's public game summary for CLE @ CHA, 2026-11-09
(game 401909953), captured 2026-11-10 11:20 EST after the game was final. Derived from the
capture: only the `header`, `boxscore` and `plays` sections are kept, and ESPN's navigation
`links` lists are removed. Every value that remains is as ESPN served it.
